<subject>FW: Summary of Meeting on Storage Allocation Adjustments</subject>
<body>
Dear Marina,

Below is the memo I circulated on March 15th summarizing the March 12th meeting. Please refer to the second bullet point in my summary. I recall Ana was unable to attend that day, but Rafael was very engaged throughout the discussion.

I was unable to locate the copy I originally sent, but fortunately, Carlos still had his version.

-----Original Message-----
From: Carlos Mendes  
Sent: Tuesday, April 2, 2024 9:45 AM  
To: Silva, Mariana  
Subject: FW: Summary of Meeting on Storage Allocation Adjustments  

For your information.

-----Original Message-----
From: Silva, Mariana  
Sent: Friday, March 15, 2024 11:30 AM  
To: Costa, Ana; Oliveira, Lucas; Ferreira, Pedro; Mendes, Carlos; Rodrigues, Tiago; Almeida, Sofia; Santos, Bruno; Lima, Eduardo; Moreira, Paula; Gomes, Thiago; Barbosa, Renata; Pinto, Marcelo; Alves, Camila; Souza, Rafael; Carvalho, Daniela  
Cc: Pereira, Ricardo; Nunes, Fernanda  
Subject: Summary of Meeting on Storage Allocation Adjustments  

Please find below a summary of our recent meeting. Should you wish to discuss further, feel free to reach out.

Subdivision of Field Area into Two Regions / Allocation by Zone  
It was decided to divide the Field Area storage group into two regions: South of Vale Verde and North of Vale Verde, instead of three regions or allocation by individual points. Should additional subdivisions be necessary in the future, we can implement those changes accordingly. Updates to the CAS system will be required. I have spoken with Ricardo Pereira and Fernanda Nunes, who advised that the updates are straightforward and can be completed within a few days.  
Rafael Souza and I will identify which deferred delivery points fall within these new field regions and then provide this information to Ricardo and Fernanda.

Question: Should this change be implemented immediately or postponed until the start of the withdrawal season?

Revision from ‘net zero’ methodology / Ensure minimum activity level  
We agreed to postpone this issue for the time being. The scheduled activity driving the allocation process does not necessarily reflect actual pipeline operations. Typically, the flexibility provided by the Vale Verde Field enables Gas Control to adjust operations to maintain the required minimum injection/withdrawal levels for the Redenção and Laguna storage sites. Further analysis is needed. Pedro Ferreira, Bruno Santos, and I will continue to monitor system conditions affecting physical storage to evaluate if any additional adjustments are warranted.

Notification when final scheduled volume exceeds operational capacity  
The IT department will update the scheduling procedure to include a step where the final net scheduled storage volume is compared against the operational capacity for storage. Should the final scheduled volume exceed operational capacity, I will receive an email notification. The goal is to track these occurrences and assess the scale of the issue. I will coordinate with Carlos Mendes to finalize this process.

Best regards,  
Mariana Silva  
BrasiLog Transportes S.A.  
</body>
